[Problem]{.card-kicker} **is this permutation a DFS order?** [CF 2002D1 · DFS Checker (Easy Version)](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/2002/D1){rating="1900"}

A DFS steps to a child of some vertex on the current root path. So the parent of the next vertex is an ancestor of the current vertex, or the current vertex itself. Together with $p_1 = 1$, that local test is also sufficient. In this heap, depth is $\lfloor \log_2 v \rfloor$, and $a$ is an ancestor of $b$ when shifting $b$ down to $a$'s depth lands on $a$.

[Solved in full in @sec-tv-p1-dfs.]{.card-link}

:::
